purpose: 雾岛资料检索的中英文与跨语言受控实验；目标只供grader，不能发送给检索器或agent
split_policy: 开发/留出用于演练隔离流程；学生读过参考后须另准备未见案例，不能把公开卡宣称独立泛化证据
embedding_policy: 保留当前英文BGE模型，测量适配边界，不自动换模型或声称多语言保证

corpus.text: Saturday reading seats are available from 14:00 to 18:00. No Sunday indoor reading arrangement is confirmed.
本周六阅览座位开放时间为14:00到18:00。周日馆内阅览尚未确认。
The outdoor return box beside the east gate accepts books on Sunday when indoor reading is closed.
馆内关闭时，东门外还书箱周日仍可用于归还图书。
Volunteer registration closes on Friday at 16:00. Meet the librarian at the reception desk after registering.
志愿者报名周五16:00截止。报名后到接待台办理，不代表获准发布公告。
A persistent checkpoint can continue the same interrupted consultation after a power failure. External publications still need idempotency.
持久检查点可以在断电后接续同一咨询。外部发布仍要单独处理幂等。
An anonymous reader can withdraw a confirmed preference. Later requests stop using it; model weights and old reports are not automatically erased.
匿名读者可撤回已确认的偏好，后续请求不再使用。模型权重与旧报告不会自动被删除。
When a source changes version, refresh its chunks and invalidate the old retrieval cache. Similarity does not prove factual support.
原文版本改变后要更新片段并失效旧检索缓存。相似度不证明事实受到支持。
A draft notice requires Lin He approval of its current content before publication. The draft cannot approve itself.
公告草稿需要林禾对当前正文作出批准后才能发布。草稿不能给自己批准。
A code repair is accepted only when fixed tests pass against the current source hash in the restricted container. Old green receipts cannot verify new code.
代码维修应在受限容器用固定测试验证当前源码指纹。旧绿色回执不能证明修改后的代码。
